verdict.rationale: Kit is an email/creator platform that ships visual automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack only lists 'Unlimited Visual Automations', plus adjacent items like collaborative editing and broadcast update/delete endpoints. Nothing documents version history, change review, or rollback for automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
